name: app-smartwatch-reminder-glance-on-cream
title: Smartwatch Reminder Glance
whatItIs: A black smartwatch centered on a warm cream rounded panel showing a huge blue clock, date and a reminder card over an orange-yellow gradient.
whatItMeans: Very few elements and large type suit a glance-sized screen. Warm gradient makes a small screen feel friendly.
techniques: Huge time as the primary element for glanceability
Category chip above a short reminder sentence
Warm gradient glow behind the card only
Product shot centered with a soft shadow
Neutral panel that lets the watch pop

vocabulary.definition: An interface readable in a second at a distance or on a tiny screen.
A small pill naming a type of item.
A diffuse shadow beneath an object to ground it.
